entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this helmet I bought. Your website is a joke and I've been on hold for twenty minutes. This is ridiculous.

I certainly apologize for the wait time. I can definitely look into that return for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Issue? The issue is that the color looks nothing like it did online! It's hideous. I want my money back. I haven't even taken it out of the plastic, the box is unopened. It's brand new.

I see. I'm sorry to hear that the color wasn't what you expected. I can understand how frustrating that would be. Let me just pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?

Don't give me the runaround about 'eligibility'. Just process the return. I'm looking at my order now, it's VF88602. If you don't do this, I'm writing a review on every website I can find and contacting the Better Business Bureau. I want to speak to your manager.

I understand your frustration, sir, and I assure you, I am empowered to handle this for you without needing a manager. I just need to verify the purchase date against our policy. We have to be thorough, especially with a safety item like a helmet. One moment while I look up order VF88602...
Okay, thank you for your patience. I see the order was delivered 22 days ago.
And? So what? As I said, the box is unopened. Your company needs to get its act together. Are you going to return it or am I wasting more of my time?

No, not at all, sir. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items. Since the helmet is in its original condition, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I expected. See? Was that so hard?

Not at all. I've just initiated the process. I am emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay, I see the email. Alright. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
